graph.title: LEGO MINDSTORMS Mini Robots (40413) - 5 models
notes: KEPT AS IS - the 'five separate groups' finding is not a real problem for this manual. LEGO set 40413 is a 5-in-1 set: the booklet builds five independent mini robots one after another (Robot with red eye, wheeled robot with arms, dog, rover with bucket arm or camera, grabber robot). Step numbering restarts at 1 for every model (pages 3, 24, 48, 58, 84), and no piece or sub-assembly is shared between models, so the graph correctly has five connected components: Model 1 = b1-b69, Model 2 = b70-b154, Model 3 (dog) = b155-b213 plus the 'leg' repeat, Model 4 (rover) = b214-b301, Model 5 (grabber) = b302-b366. Inventing joins between different models would be wrong. Ids are in build order.

Part ids b189-b204 are intentionally absent: the four dog legs (axle 2, foot hub 22961, 135 degree connector 32192, upper leg 42003) are expressed as the 'leg' repeat (4 pieces x 4 copies = 16 parts), attached to blue pins b182, b183, b187, b188.

Piece identification from small icons was made by matching to the parts list counts (every type/colour count in the inventory is used exactly once). Look-alike parts were resolved that way (e.g. 87083 vs 3705 axle 4 in model 1 step 3, 3937 hinge base in step 6 of the wheeled robot, 14704 socket vs 14417 ball).

Most plate/brick joins are given with null ports because exact stud positions cannot be distinguished in the isometric pictures; stud/anti-stud contacts between layers are approximated by joining each new piece to the piece it visibly sits on.
Model 4 (rover): the bucket arm tower (b270-b284) and the camera tower (b285-b301) are alternatives shown on page 83; both are recorded as joined to b248 although only one is fitted at a time.
Model 2: the head attaches to the body by ball/socket (14704 on 14417); the collar (b152-b154) rests on the cover and is only recorded as contact.

Model 1: hub pin holes (15100 pin-hole.1/2) used for leg and arm pins are assigned approximately; the head attaches via the pins of 15461 into the two 6541 bricks. Trans-red projectile b69 is inserted at the arm elbow (b36) per the red inset on page 23.

graph_initial.title: LEGO MINDSTORMS Mini Robots (40413) - 5 models
notes: The booklet has five models built in order: (1) Robot b1-b69, (2) wheeled robot b70-b213 (incl. dog's neighbours) -> actually Model 2 = b70-b154 chassis/head, Model 3 (dog) = b155-b213, Model 4 (rover with arm / camera) = b214-b301, Model 5 (grabber bot) = b302-b366. Ids are assigned in build order.

Part ids b189-b204 are intentionally absent: the four dog legs (axle 2, foot hub 22961, 135deg connector 32192, upper leg 42003) are expressed as the 'leg' repeat (4 pieces x 4 = 16 parts), attached to blue pins b182, b183, b187, b188.

Piece identification from small icons was made by matching to the parts list counts (every type/colour count in the inventory is used exactly once). Some look-alike parts (e.g. 87083 vs 3705 axle 4 in Robot step 3, 3937 hinge base in step 6 of the wheeled robot, 14704 socket vs 14417 ball) were resolved that way.

Most plate/brick joins are given with null ports because exact stud positions are not distinguishable in the isometric pictures; stud/anti-stud contacts between adjacent layers are approximated by joining each new piece to the piece it visibly sits on.
Model 4 (rover): the bucket arm tower (b270-b284) and the camera tower (b285-b301) are alternatives shown on page 83; both are recorded as joined to b248 although only one is fitted at a time.
Model 2: head attaches to the body by ball/socket (14704 on 14417); the collar (b152-b154) rests on the cover and is only recorded as contact.
Model 1 hub pin holes (15100 pin-hole.1/2) used for leg and arm pins are assigned approximately; Robot head attaches via pins of 15461 into the two 6541 bricks.
Trans-Red projectile b69 is inserted at the arm elbow (b36) per the red inset on page 23.
